description: Query Threat Intel Indicators telemetry data from OneUptime. IMPORTANT: telemetry tables are large — always filter by a time range and keep limits small (e.g. 10-50). Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 10, Maximum: 100. Keep small for telemetry queries.

query.description: Filter criteria for Threat Intel Indicators. Always include a time-range filter.
